lines: 大炎武安三年，淮湘城，湘水河畔。
阴云密布，干枯的柳条在风中摇摆，浑浊的湘水裹着黄沙，湍急流淌。
空气中弥漫着河底的腥臭味，扑向河边的男女。
“楚生，我真后悔和你在一起！”少女站在青石上，面朝着湍急的湘水，纤细的手指抓住裙摆，精致的五官有些冰冷。
和成人一样高大的楚生，看向少女的背影，无奈道：“玉儿，我没得选！”
“你别这么叫我，真恶心。”柳玉转过身体，双眼盯着楚生，愤怒道：“你没得选？考科举，进武馆，哪一个不比当屠夫好？”
柳玉看着眼前挺拔的少年，再想到屠宰场那恶臭的场景，身体不由得有些反胃，捂住口鼻，发声道：
“你现在要去当屠夫，让我的脸往哪里放？”
楚生心生悔意，就不该告诉柳玉，自己还是太天真了，淡淡道：
“科举，学武，哪一个不需要大量的钱财？”
“要钱？你母亲，你大哥，你妹妹，他们三个都去做工挣钱，都攒不到十两银吗？”
“你不懂！”
听到楚生的话，柳玉更是气愤，甩开裙摆，绝情道：
“我们分开吧，不要再联系了！”
看着少女离开的背影，楚生淡淡道：“这样也好！”
“感情，终究敌不过现实！”
看着奔流的湘水，对岸的大山压得人喘不过气来。
楚生意念一动，眼前浮现一个红色面板。
【姓名：楚生】
【修为进度：淬皮境初阶70100】
【境界：未激活】
【武技：未激活】
杀戮系统！
只要杀戮，就可以获得杀戮值，给其他栏加点！
“穿越十四年，激活杀戮系统十二年，踩蚂蚁、杀家禽、上山打猎十二年，还是不能突破淬皮境武者，靠杀戮获得数值，可真难啊！”
一丝微风拂过，楚生松了一口气，自言自语道：
“现在十四岁，终于可以‘择业’了!”
“去武馆学武，就得按部就班练武，功法、药液都需要钱，就凭家里的情况，不知道什么时候才能成为一个强大武者！”
“唯有当屠夫，才能源源不断地获得杀戮值，这样我就可以快速变强，母亲也不用受苦了。”
想起家人，楚生眼眸中充满斗志，朝着回家的方向走去。
走到青石街，街道上很是热闹。
街道两侧全是店铺，店铺门口还有各种摊贩，中间车水马龙。
卖包子的小贩高声叫卖招揽客人，见到身着布衣的男孩盯着冒着热气的包子直流口水，那男孩递上两文钱，小贩取出包子递过去，男孩双手接住一个热腾腾的包子，然后跟着几个小伙伴兴高采烈地在街道上奔跑。
旁边面馆里，一位老人正吃着清汤面，看着这几个活蹦乱跳的娃娃跌跌撞撞穿梭人群，老人脸上笑出皱纹，满是慈祥。
楚生顺着老人的视线看去，却见一家店铺门口的人群聚在一起，里面传出嘈杂的声音。
content_en:
In the third year of Wu'an in the Great Yan Dynasty, Huaixiang City was located on the banks of the Xiangshui River.
The clouds are thick, the dry wicker branches are swaying in the wind, and the turbid Xiang River is wrapped in yellow sand and flowing rapidly.
The air was filled with the fishy smell of the river bottom, and it pounced on the men and women by the river.
"Chu Sheng, I really regret being with you!" The girl stood on the bluestone, facing the rushing Xiangshui River, her slender fingers grasping the hem of her skirt, her delicate facial features a little cold.
Chu Sheng, who was as tall as an adult, looked at the girl's back and said helplessly: "Yu'er, I have no choice!"
"Don't call me that, it's disgusting." Liu Yu turned around, stared at Chu Sheng, and said angrily: "You have no choice? Taking the imperial examination or entering a martial arts school, which one is better than being a butcher?"
Liu Yu looked at the upright young man in front of her, and then thought of the stench of the slaughterhouse. She couldn't help but feel nauseated. She covered her mouth and nose and said:
"Now that you're going to be a butcher, where do you want me to put my face?"
Chu Sheng felt regretful and shouldn't have told Liu Yu. He was still too naive and said calmly:
"Imperial examination or martial arts training, which one doesn't require a lot of money?"
"You want money? Your mother, your eldest brother, and your sister all go to work to earn money, but they can't save ten taels of silver?"
"You don't understand!"
Hearing Chu Sheng's words, Liu Yu became even more angry. She threw off her skirt and said ruthlessly:
"Let's separate and stop contacting each other!"
Looking at the girl's leaving figure, Chu Sheng said calmly: "That's fine!"
"Emotions are no match for reality after all!"
Looking at the rushing Xiang River, the mountains on the other side are so heavy that people can’t breathe.
Chu Sheng thought, and a red panel appeared in front of his eyes.
[Name: Chu Sheng]
[Kill value: 3.6]
[Qi and blood: 20]
[Cultivation Progress: Skin Tempering Realm Beginner Level 70100]
[Exercise: "Five Elements Technique" 50100]
[Realm: Inactive]
[Martial skills: not activated]
Killing system!
As long as you kill, you can get the kill value and add points to other columns!
"Fourteen years of traveling through time, activating the killing system for 12 years, stepping on ants, killing poultry, and hunting in the mountains for 12 years, and still can't break through to the Skin Tempering Realm warrior. It's really difficult to gain values by killing!"
As a breeze blew by, Chu Sheng breathed a sigh of relief and said to himself:
"Now that I'm fourteen, I can finally 'choose a career'!"
"When you go to a martial arts school to learn martial arts, you have to practice martial arts step by step. The techniques and medicines all require money. Depending on the situation at home, I don't know when I will become a powerful martial artist!"
"Only by becoming a butcher can I continuously gain killing points. In this way, I can become stronger quickly and my mother will not have to suffer."
Thinking of his family, Chu Sheng's eyes were full of fighting spirit and he walked towards home.
When we walked to Qingshi Street, the street was very lively.
There are shops on both sides of the street, and there are various vendors in front of the shops, and there is a lot of traffic in the middle.
The bun vendor shouted loudly to attract customers. When he saw a boy in cloth drooling while staring at the steaming buns, the boy handed over two cents. The vendor took out the buns and handed them over. The boy caught a steaming bun with both hands, and then followed several friends and ran happily on the street.
In the noodle shop next to them, an old man was eating clear soup noodles. Watching these lively dolls stumbling through the crowd, the old man smiled with wrinkles on his face, full of kindness.
Chu Sheng followed the old man's line of sight and saw a crowd gathering in front of a shop, and there was noisy noise coming from inside.
